title: VITALS BARS ONE WIDTH
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): the hp, armour and stamina bars have three widths (360, 280, 280).
now: HP, armour and stamina bars are the same width.

edits.replacement: bar(16,by-46,HBW,16,p.armor/armorCap(),'#5aa9e6');   /* v28.xx (cw-barsame), the critic (2026-10-19): the three vitals bars had three widths (360, 280, 280); all are HBW wide now */
bar(16,by-25,HBW,12,p.stam/100,_stc);   /* v28.xx (cw-barsame): same width as the health bar */
ctx.fillText(p.stamLock?'WINDED':'STAMINA',16+HBW+8,by-15);   /* v28.xx (cw-barsame): the word follows the longer bar */
